v2_native_provenance.requirements: warp16 in CTA0/CTA1; payload equals CTA rank when the decoder retains marker payloads; source-native 20-warp role layout

semantics.active_segments: Filled bars and overlap metrics use the interval union of member_cta_intervals. The role envelope is outline-only, so gaps between CTA members do not become fabricated overlap.
semantics.cross_implementation: Each capture has its own t=0. Zoom panels compare pipeline shape, not simultaneous execution or absolute alignment.
semantics.overlap_ratio: intersection(active unions) / min(active union A, active union B); this is observed software-span overlap, not critical-path contribution
semantics.role_track: Role is a display track. Events remain separated by aligned semantic name, logical tile, and substep.
semantics.timestamp: IKET software-annotation interval; not asynchronous TMA/UMMA/atomic retirement or GMEM visibility
